scope: Display entry separation, overlay scrolling, preference persistence, WCAG AA, representative layouts, all-route desktop/mobile regression

tests.title: representative pages satisfy automated WCAG AA checks in both themes and languages
viewport widths, 200 percent layout and keyboard modal focus remain usable
theme has its own entry; language and time zone share a separate entry and persist independently
sidebar, business navigation, workspace tabs and database tables use overlay scrollbars without losing scrolling
design system: table, form validation, focus, theme, locale and responsive samples
profile drafts survive header preference changes; saved theme, language and tabs survive reload
all existing business routes render at desktop and mobile without page errors, missing translations or document overflow
dictionary editing is independent of selecting its type and database filtering has an explicit empty state
SQL sorting sends the requested server ordering and document export produces a downloadable file
423 opens the lock overlay and failed preference writes restore local appearance
